systemSettings.currencyIncrementHint: HALF_UP rounding of every MAD amount (lines, ticket, stamp duty, tip, cash, change). Morocco: 0.10. Percentage rates are not amounts. Catalogue prices are unchanged (14.50 − 10% → 13.10; 0.25% stamp on 100 → 0.30).

systemSettings.a4LabelShowPriceHint: If enabled: A4 and roll labels show the sale price under the name (same 50 × 30 mm template). Disabled by default.
systemSettings.staffLockOnLoginHint: If enabled: a cashier lands on POS (shop) or floor (restaurant) without the ERP menu; manager password to exit. Off by default: the role is enough.
systemSettings.staffLockIdleSecondsHint: Idle time before the staff face wall. Default 90 s. 0 = never auto-lock. Maximum 3600 s (1 h).
systemSettings.situationReminderDaysHint: Credit customers to remind if the last checkpoint is older than this delay. Default 30 days. A delay on the customer card overrides this value.
systemSettings.posExpressModeDefaultHint: When starting the sales POS, hides product search and shows quick products first.
systemSettings.disableStockManagementHint: If enabled: no stock check at checkout and no stock movements on customer invoices and delivery notes. with no saved value, enabled by default for Café, Restaurant and Snack types.
systemSettings.allowNegativeStockHint: If enabled (stock management on): a sale or delivery note can take sellable stock below zero. At the till, Charge asks for confirmation. Disabled by default.
systemSettings.stockLotsEnabledHint: If enabled: stock lot tracking, FEFO consumption (first expiry date) on sales and lot receipts. requires stock management enabled. disabled by default.
systemSettings.lotNumberFromExpiryHint: When entering the expiry date, the lot number is filled automatically (e.g.. 20260531). manually editable.
systemSettings.inventoryBlindCountHint: If enabled: during counting, system quantities, variances and valuations are hidden (including lot detail). global setting for all users.
systemSettings.qrClientOrderEnabledHint: If enabled: the customer can order from the table QR (menu + cart), without year account. disabled by default.
systemSettings.tipsEnabledHint: If enabled: a Tip line (amount) in POS payments. Outside the invoice total. Cash (drawer) or included in the card payment.
systemSettings.tipsPresetsPercentHint: List séparée with of virgules, e.g.. 5,10,15
systemSettings.kdsSlaHint: Time before turning orange (warning) then red (danger) on the KDS. Default 15 min / 25 min. A product can have its own threshold (prepTargetMinutes).
systemSettings.recipeStockOnServedHint: Automatically decrements ingredient stock when a dish is marked as served in the kitchen. Opt-in — disabled by default.
systemSettings.kitchenPrintAfterSendHint: After send-to-kitchen, the ticket prints on the station ESC/POS printer (Kitchen), not as a waiter-side PDF. Opt-in — off by default. Configure the printer:
systemSettings.stampDutyRatesHint: Rate in % applied to the collected share of each method (excluding the duty itself). Default 0. E.g. Morocco cash: 0.25. Outside invoice turnover, like tips.
